Store Pickup pod
Store Pickup · Meesho · leadership review

Answer first, call later

14% of buyers who call a pickup store call at night. We stop that call at the tap and answer their question in the app instead.

01 — Problem

Night calls are frequent for buyers, costly per call

14%Calling users who call at night9,340 of 65,746 · 10 PM to 6 AM
≤ 1Night calls per store per dayP90 store gets 7 calls a day
LostOrder, in our LODBuyer called at 11:55 PM, got scolded, didn’t order

Why it matters

02 — Solution

When the store is closed, Call Store answers instead of dialling

Tap Call Store at night and this sheet opens instead of dialling: the store is closed, its hours, and three answers. The only button is Okay. Picked from six final variants; all six are in the pre-read.

What the sheet does

Status

Closed first, then the hours

“Store is closed now”, then the store’s own hours in a pill, e.g. 8:30 AM – 9:30 PM.

Answers

Three merged answers

When it reaches the store and that it waits 3 days; it stays sealed and the OTP is only for the counter; how far the store is, with a landmark and map.

Action

Okay, no dial

At night there’s no call to make. The buyer gets the answer and keeps going.

Decisions we need

Decision 1

Run the night-sheet test

Go-ahead to test the closed-store sheet against a no-sheet control.

Decision 2

Go with option 3?

Store closed first, hours in a pill. Quick to build. The video variants (5 and 6) need motion designer bandwidth.

Decision 3

Also test in store hours?

Same answers during the day, with Call Store after them. Worth a second arm, or not yet?
